about.text: A full-fat hard cheese of about 32 to 33 kg, close to Gruyère in style but smoother, with no holes. It is made from raw cow's milk in village dairies of the canton of Schwyz, pressed for at least 16 hours, brined for up to 36 hours and sold mostly in the region and around Zurich.

sources.text: The making, ripening, size and region, from this article.
